name: naming-drift-data-reads
title: Naming drift — new credit-note reads are named get*/fetch* where every data module uses find*/list*

pullRequest.title: Show credit notes in the customer portal
pullRequest.body: Finance issues credit notes against invoices, and customers can't see them yet. This adds the credit note data module, a service that hides credit notes on voided invoices, and two portal endpoints.
pullRequest.author: dana-okafor
